notes: CORRECTED (orchestrator verify pass, 2026-09-04): the worker's original pass found robots.txt entries disallowing ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, and Claude-Web with 'Disallow: /' each - a full-site opt-out repeated across every named Claude user agent - but reasoned that since access was via Playwright/CDP (not literally the mcp__claude-in-chrome__ tool), 'Claude-in-Chrome was never needed/used, so this did not block the run', and proceeded to extract 18 rows anyway. This is the identical policy-interpretation error independently corrected this same batch on se281.json (home24 Germany): the project's hard rule is that a named Claude-user-agent full-site disallow means STOP regardless of access tier, 'even if the WAF is trivially bypassable' - the rule exists specifically to prevent routing around a site's Claude opt-out using a different technical method once the direct method is blocked, which is exactly what happened here (Tier 1 was blocked by Amazon's WAF, so the worker escalated to a real Playwright browser and proceeded despite the robots.txt finding). All 18 originally-extracted rows (13 Christmas sub-categories under Seasonal Décor incl. Stockings & Holders 398, Trees 395, Tree Care & Watering 769, Tree Trays & Mats 72 plus 9 capped/MANUAL REVIEW counts; Diwali - Diyas & Lanterns and Rangoli; New Year Decorations 669; Japanese Boys' Festival 1; Japanese Girls' Doll Festival 4) were discarded - none were access-authorized data. This is not a claim that amazon.ae lacks these categories (the discarded taxonomy discovery - a genuine 'Seasonal Décor' node 12148153031 with 27 children - strongly suggests it does) - it is a policy opt-out, not a content finding. The worker's taxonomy map (node IDs, which children are genuine vs. generic-and-excluded) could inform a future non-Claude-attributed re-check of this company, but qty/evidence values would need fresh re-verification since they were never legitimately obtained. The worker's separate borderline-judgement note on Snow Globes (node 12148746031) logged to qa_notes.md is moot given this correction and should be disregarded along with the rest of the extraction.
